# Yautja Honor Code
The [bold]Yautja Honor Code[/bold] is a set of rules all Yautja players are required to follow. Failure to uphold these rules may result in the suspension or removal of your Predator whitelist.
If you break the Honor Code while hunting prey, you are to cease your hunt of that prey. If you critically injure them, bring them back to their teammates: - Xenomorphs to their weeds. - Marines to their squadmates or fortifications. - Colonists and CLF to the colony hospital.
Should you be unable to because of a threat or time constraints, you will not be penalized. However, you should be prepared to defend your initial actions should a report be filed.
The Honor Code will be updated as new content is added. For who the Yautja are and where they come from, see the [textlink="Yautja lore" link="CMUGuideLoreHunters"].
[color=#ff0000][bold]To non-whitelisted players:[/bold][/color] anyone looking to make a whitelist report is kindly asked and expected to read the Honor Code thoroughly before making the report.
